title: AI Employee Declaration
description: Per-project declaration of autonomous AI behavior (rule: .claude/rules/ai-native.md). Must be accurate and match implemented functionality -- every does_autonomously item maps to shipped code or is marked 'planned'. Lives at repo root as ai-employee.json, or .forge/ai/<project-slug>.json for VibePromptRig plugin customers. NOTE: removed_ai_pct carries maximum 70 BY DESIGN -- the ai-native.md SS2 band gate. A genuinely simple tool (>70% workflows AI-free) is exempted via a DECISIONS.md note and does NOT carry this file at all; the exemption replaces the declaration.

does_autonomously.description: Tasks the AI performs autonomously without human intervention in the current shipped version. Mark planned items clearly.

works_with_you_on.description: Tasks where AI assists and a human must approve or edit before action is taken.

learns_from.description: Signals and feedback mechanisms that improve future outputs for this specific user (e.g. accept/dismiss, manual edits, outcome tracking, prompt_version logging).

time.description: Estimated time saved per typical session

money.description: Estimated financial value or cost avoided

energy.description: Reduction in mental load or repetitive toil

unlocks_full_agent_after.description: Condition or loop count required before higher agency is enabled

removed_ai_pct.description: Percentage of PRIMARY USER WORKFLOWS completable WITHOUT AI inference (the refined Removed-AI metric, ai-native.md SS2). Bands: <=40 auto-pass; 41-70 requires a DECISIONS.md justification; >70 is schema-BLOCKED -- a deliberately simple tool takes the DECISIONS.md exemption instead of carrying this file.

verified_claims.description: Specific claims made in UI, marketing, or docs that have been implemented, tested, and are currently delivered.

guardrails.description: The Truth & Compliance Shield contract (ai-native.md SS4): what the AI is mechanically forbidden to do, what real sources ground its output, and which disclaimers its surfaces must carry.

forbidden_actions.description: Actions the AI must NEVER take autonomously (e.g. execute commands, write to the DB directly, send external messages, spend money, delete data).

grounding_source.description: The real data sources every AI output must be grounded in / cite (no source = no claim).

legal_disclaimers_required.description: Disclaimers that MUST render with this project's AI output (empty array allowed only for genuinely no-stakes output).

notes.description: Optional context, planned improvements, or known limitations.

last_updated.description: Date this declaration was last reviewed and updated
